title: Amazing views and lovely experience 10/10
text: Great location for sipping sangria - we enjoyed a gorgeous autumnal sunset with gorgeous views across the river. We had a lovely couple of hours learning a little more about 4 different sangrias and how they are made and some historical context to them... loved the final sangria - very unusual! We also enjoyed some local Manchego cheese and olive tapas too. Would definitely recommend on a short trip to Seville.
author: T7982AElesleyh

title: This sangria tasting was...
text: This sangria tasting was very fun! I enjoyed learning about the history of sangria and how some of the more modern takes on sangria came to be. The sangrias themselves were also very good. The tasting takes place on a rooftop overlooking the river, and the 7:30 tasting was perfect because not only did we get to enjoy the sangrias and learn more about them, but we got to watch a beautiful sunset from above the city!
author: Tiarra_J

title: Highly recommended
text: Our host Eyrian was absolutely lovely, really funny and friendly. The value for money on the sangria tasting was exceptional, 4 different sangrias; sherry, white, red and sparkling rose. Each with their own historical background. The tour takes place on a rooftops with views of the Cathedral and over the river, simply stunning. My partner and I absolutely loved this tour and would highly recommend it.
author: Eden_C

title: A fun and refreshing experience in the heart of Seville!
text: The rooftop setting was beautiful, with amazing city views, and tasting the different sangrias was a great way to discover local flavors. The olives and cheese were the perfect addition, making it a memorable and enjoyable experience.
author: paucxmbil

title: Book it!
text: Really lovely afternoon with Fabio, such a nice and knowledgeable guy. We loved trying all the different sangrias of Seville. Thank you!
author: Denise_B

title: Knowledge, Taste, Kindness, & View
text:
Our host was incredibly knowledgeable, the sangria was delicious, & meeting new people was fun!
Thank you for an enjoyable evening!
*OH, &’the view was spectacular!
author: Staci_D

title: Great Sangria tour!
text: This was a great sangria tour, and we got to taste different types, and we enjoyed all of the options. The guide was also great, and very insightful into the sangria types we sampled. We’d definitely recommend this tour and add the extra refills if possible, as the rooftop bar where this took place was great to see the city and watch the sunset!
author: Dylan_S

title: Wine Tasting Great Experience
text: 4 tastings (the first had two - bonus)! Variety of white, red & bubbly. Really yummy and flavourful. Rooftop, high top table setting.
author: Nieve_R

title: Great time !
text: Such a Great experience! Not only do you get a lot of sangria you get so much history with a fantastic rooftop view. A+ to our guide !!
author: Georgia_G

title: Incredible Seville Experience
text: The Sangria tasting experience was incredible! The views alone made the experience magical. On top of that we got to have 4 glasses of different sangrias and it was the perfect afternoon. Our guide Fabio was so gracious and knowledgeable - he told us about the origins of the drinks and the recipes and a bit about the region. Would recommended to anyone coming to Seville - sign up for the experience. It was about 90 minutes and the rooftop had stunning views of the city, the river, and the hills.
author: James_D
